text: A bus moves in a straight line between two bus stops. The bus starts from rest and accelerates at
2.1 m s for 5 s. The bus then travels for 24 s at constant speed and finally slows down, with a constant
deceleration, stopping in a further 6 s. Sketch a velocity-time graph for the motion and hence find the
distance between the two bus stops. [5]
